items.source_excerpt: The role of the UK Emissions Trading Scheme in UK decarbonisation and how the UK ETS Authority is developing the scheme. The UK Emissions Trading Scheme ( UK ETS ) currently covers the heavy industry, power and aviation sectors – approximately 25% of UK territorial emissions. The scheme incentivises investment in decarbonisation in line with climate targets across the UK, by setting a cap on emissions from these sectors and creating a carbon price. The UK ETS Authority (consisting of the UK, Scottish, and Welsh Governments, and the Northern Ireland Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs) is working to expand and develop the scheme to incentivise additional sectors of the economy. This sets out: the policy aims of the UK ETS how it works the work the UK ETS Authority is doing to develop it We will update the content as further policy updates are published. items.title_original: Keeping records for Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
items.summary_zh: 10月16日更新说明注册于2028年1月1日开放；进口CBAM货物记录从2027年1月1日起保存，通常自建档日或相关会计期末中较晚者起6年。记录包括8位商品编码、品名、税点日期、价值、净重及豁免证据；申报另须季度与原产地证据。实际值需保存核查报告或产品摘要，无实际数据或核查证据时须用默认值。不留档可处£500固定罚款，未应要求提供资料还可能另罚。
items.summary_en: Records of in-scope imports begin on 1 January 2027 although registration opens on 1 January 2028. Normally retain records for six years from the later of creation or accounting-period end, including eight-digit code, description, tax point, value, net weight and exemption evidence. Actual data need verification evidence. A £500 record-keeping penalty and separate information penalties may apply.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂应向英国客户提供可追溯净重、编码、原产地和排放文件；客户需把2027年记录义务与2028年注册分别排期。指南部分“稍后发布”表述滞后于已发布默认值和MRV指南，具体数值应查10月16日专门文件。
items.impact_en: Supply traceable weight, classification, origin and emissions evidence. Plan 2027 record keeping separately from 2028 registration. Use the dedicated October default-value/MRV publications where older forward-looking wording on this page is stale.

items.summary_zh: HMRC于10月16日发布税率指引：铝、水泥、化肥、氢及钢铁分别适用行业税率，并根据英国ETS所反映的有效碳价按季度变化。适用税率由货物行业和进口季度决定，按商品编码判断行业；2027年起在每季度开始前后公布。当前示例税率不能替代正式季度税率。
items.summary_en: HMRC’s 16 October guidance sets separate sector rates for aluminium, cement, fertilisers, hydrogen, and iron and steel. Rates reflect the effective UK carbon price and vary quarterly. Product classification and the import quarter determine the applicable rate; illustrative figures are not live quarterly rates.
items.impact_zh: 对英合同应将货物排放强度（tCO₂e/t）与行业碳税率（GBP/tCO₂e）分列，按预计进口季度测算并设置调整条款。不要用示例金额锁定所有2027年订单的税费。
items.impact_en: Separate product emissions intensity from the GBP/tCO2e sector rate in UK contracts and update estimates for the expected import quarter. Do not lock all 2027 orders to illustrative figures.
items.source_excerpt: Find out about rates for CBAM goods and how they apply to your imports. For example, if you import steel bars in February 2028, the CBAM rate that applies is for iron and steel between 1 January to 31 March 2028.

items.summary_zh: HMRC10月16日发布默认值。钢铁表以tCO₂e/吨产品列示，当前不按原产地分别取值；示例编码72071210连铸／轧制板坯3.571，72071290锻造板坯4.748。最终产品用实际值时，可对前体材料使用默认值；反过来不能把实际前体值与最终产品默认值拼接。官方指引明确：默认值提交的申报不能随后改成实际值。相关公告仍标Draft，公布值用于准备2027年实施，不能视为今天已起征。
items.summary_en: The official steel table uses tCO2e per tonne regardless of origin: 72071210 rolled/continuously cast slab is 3.571 and 72071290 forged slab 4.748. Defaults may cover precursors within an actual-value final-product calculation, not actual precursors within a final-product default. Submitted default-value returns cannot later be amended to actual data. The linked notice remains Draft ahead of 2027 commencement.
items.impact_zh: 出口商应先核对完整8位编码与产品制造方式，再向进口商比较核查实际值与默认值方案，并在提交前拿齐证据。上述数值是英国口径，不是中国BOF路线的欧盟默认值，也不能单凭该值确定每吨钢材税额。
items.impact_en: Verify the full code and manufacturing method and obtain evidence before filing. These are UK values, not EU Chinese BOF defaults, and do not alone establish a per-tonne tax bill.

items.summary_zh: 10月16日示例文件按当前初步数据演示行业税率：钢铁£9.69、铝£9.79、水泥£8.78、化肥£1.45、氢£9.24，单位均为每吨CO₂当量。数据包括2026年第三季度UK ETS拍卖均价£58.15及仍待核查的基线数据。水泥例子为£58.15×[1−87.1%×97.5%]≈£8.78。官方明确这些不是预测或正式计税依据；2027年第一季度正式税率将在年底前公布。
items.summary_en: Illustrative rates are iron/steel £9.69, aluminium £9.79, cement £8.78, fertiliser £1.45 and hydrogen £9.24 per tCO2e. Inputs include Q3 2026 UK ETS auction average £58.15 and provisional baseline data. The cement example is £58.15×[1−87.1%×97.5%]≈£8.78. Figures are neither forecasts nor live tax rates; Q1 2027 rates are due before year-end.
items.impact_zh: 示例可用于报价敏感性测算，钢铁£9.69不能当作每吨钢材税额；仍需乘适用排放强度、按实际数量计算并核对碳价减免。正式价格发布后更新合同测算，不能直接套欧盟购证公式。
items.impact_en: Use for sensitivity estimates only. £9.69 is per tonne of CO2e, not per tonne of steel: apply relevant intensity and quantity and check relief. Refresh contracts when live rates appear.
items.source_excerpt: Find out how sector-level CBAM rates are calculated under the CBAM rate methodology using illustrative rates and worked example. The UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism ( CBAM ) is designed to address the risk of carbon leakage as the UK decarbonises its economy. It does this by applying a carbon price to imported goods in covered sectors that reflects the carbon price faced by comparable domestic production. Unlike most taxes, CBAM does not have a single headline rate set out in primary legislation. Instead, the rate is determined using a methodology that combines recent carbon pricing data, sector-level emissions information and the extent to which domestic producers continue to receive free allowances under the UK Emissions Trading Scheme. This methodology is set out in law, via the Finance Act 2026. The purpose of this note is to explain how sector-level CBAM rates are calculated under the CBAM rate methodology. It is intended as a transparency tool to help businesses understand…

items.summary_zh: 进口隐含排放由重量乘排放强度计算；实际值须有合格核查机构出具的报告，注明强度和完整日历年监测期。可选生产年份口径，或按进口年份关联：2027年进口使用可取得的最新2027年核查数据，未取得时可用2026年数据；2028年起进口使用此前两个日历年中最新可用的核查数据。也可使用政府默认值。
items.summary_en: Embodied emissions equal product weight multiplied by emissions intensity. Actual data require an eligible verifier’s report identifying intensity and the calendar-year monitoring period. Data may link to production year, or import year: for 2027 imports use available verified 2027 data, otherwise 2026; from 2028 use the latest available verified year within the preceding two calendar years. Default values are an alternative.
items.impact_zh: 钢厂须与英国进口商约定采用哪一种年度关联方式，匹配产品、生产年份、报告和供货记录。不能把一次检测、单炉废钢比例或未经核查的内部估算直接当成年度排放强度。
items.impact_en: Agree the year-linking method with the importer and match product, production-year, verification and shipment records. A spot test or unverified scrap-ratio estimate does not establish annual intensity.

items.source_excerpt: Find out about the force of law notice for the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism and reference document. Force of law notices These documents are in draft. ‘The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Administrative Provisions and Determination of Carbon Price Relief) Force of Law Notice (Draft)’ was published on 14 July 2026 alongside the relevant CBAM secondary legislation being laid in parliament. ‘The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Emissions and Verification) Force of Law Notice (Draft)’ was published on the 9 September 2026 alongside the relevant CBAM secondary legislation being laid in parliament. ‘The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (Default Values) Force of Law Notice (Draft)’ was published on the 16 October 2026. The notices have not yet commenced and do not currently have the force of law. It will only come into effect once it has been commenced on 1 January 2027. It includes the core policy framework which is set out via primary legislation in the Finance Act 2026 and details set out in the draft secondary legislation and notices.
